games.context: Boston (13-6-1) visit Detroit (8-10-3) on TNT, and Detroit are narrow home favourites. The Bruins have lost their last two at home, 5-2 to Montreal and 6-2 to Minnesota, while Detroit won 2-0 at Tampa Bay last time out after four straight losses. Detroit are still without captain Dylan Larkin, who has been suspended without pay since leaving the team on 29 Oct, and Boston are without rookie James Hagens (back, IR). Daniil Tarasov (1.69 GAA, .937) is confirmed for Detroit and Jeremy Swayman is Boston's expected starter. The total is 5.5, with the over favoured.

games.context: Colorado (12-6-3, 6-2-2 in their last 10) visit Utah (10-9-3), who are on a six-game losing streak, on TNT. The Avalanche are without Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar (both lower body) as well as Josh Manson, and the moneyline is close to even. Utah are missing Logan Cooley, Nick Schmaltz and Dylan Guenther up front plus defencemen John Marino and Nate Schmidt. Colorado score 4.05 goals a game, second in the NHL; Utah's power play converts 33.8% but their penalty kill is 28th at 69.3%. Mackenzie Blackwood and Karel Vejmelka are the expected goalies (not confirmed).

games.context: First Southern Urals derby of the season (17:00 Moscow time). Metallurg (19-6-3, 41 pts, 1st in the East, a league-high 101 goals per the KHL) won 7-2 at Lada on Tuesday after losing 4-5 at Barys and 3-4 in OT to Avangard; Traktor (12-11-5, 29 pts, 8th in the East) end a four-game road trip after a 1-4 loss at Sibir and have alternated wins and defeats over their last six. Traktor won the last derby 6-2 in Chelyabinsk on 18 Mar 2026, but Metallurg won the other five 2025-26 meetings.

news.text: Sergei Tolchinsky has a nine-game point streak (3G+10A in that span), Nathan Todd has 2G+4A in a four-game streak and Daniil Vovchenko 4G+3A in three games. Tolchinsky is fifth and Todd eighth in the KHL player rating.

On Wednesday Metallurg traded Ruslan Iskhakov and Igor Nechayev to Spartak for Mikhail Maltsev and Ivan Morozov. Goalie Alexander Smolin may play his 100th KHL game; Valery Orekhov is one assist short of 100.
